newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both the dollar and pound on Monday, following international trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.1415 against the dollar from 20.1115 last Friday. On the pound, the rupee traded at a mean rate of 32.797 from 32.730 last Friday.
Dealers said in the absence of influencing factors on the local front, the rupee's fixing reflected the firmer U.S. currency in overnight international markets.
They added that forex demand from importers had picked up from the end of year lull but this was not exerting a weakening pressure on the rupee.
"The market is still liquid and the central bank interventions are maintaining the rupee at a stable level at the moment," one dealer said.
During market interventions over the past few weeks, the central bank was seen selling dollars at the prevailing interbank market rates.
Such interventions are having a stabilising effect on the local currency, dealers said.
